stretch.task: Add a status message explaining which protection is missing.
stretch.hint: Use IF/ELSE IF to give separate outcomes.
stretch.answer: Encrypted true/backups false -> Backup required; both true -> Ready.

mastery.task: Design a preparedness checker using encryption, verified backup and update status; prioritise missing controls and justify their roles.
mastery.hint: Report every missing control, not just first.
mastery.answer: Test all true -> Ready; missing backup -> recovery risk; missing updates -> vulnerability risk; missing encryption -> confidentiality risk.
